notes:
The sheet continues a cancelled construction using an invertible sheaf on a pinched curve, then considers translations on Jacobians and a possible disjointness argument. The oblique note explicitly says that the needed vanishing in the complemented Jacobian is not known. The later bracket retains the written implication that a point in the kernel gives a disjoint translate; no nonzero restriction is inserted. The main reader actually refuted that literal implication by u=0, as recorded in check_events. This establishes a necessary exclusion, not the truth of the nonzero version. The text then switches to a homological formulation, with a locally cancelled doubtful co prefix before homologique. Small forms are not expanded: barred m, barred ms, inv., pt, hyp., élts, and the unresolved du m / celui-ci remain literal. The parenthetical does not visibly contain si or a separate g. The raised de J insertion has a bare Y subscript and an uncertain 1/0 exponent; degree one is an expectation, not a visual resolution. The short dash in the kernel is left unheaded. The final map is single, hooked and labelled i. The page contains no new standalone drawing. Thin bottom foliation 37 is retained as a margin entry and distinguished from authorial numbering; no separate authorial page number is visible at the top. No OCR, external source, or TeX compilation was used.

[Blind audit] The cancelled construction after Y-prime now favours an amalgam-like sign with I below, retaining quotient-by-I as an alternative under the scribble. The small local deletion reads two groups, en un, still doubtful. The oblique note begins Cependant / Comment; its early compressed letters no longer justify the previous high confidence. At M1088 the initial large curve itself is uncertain as parenthesis versus initial c, so the alternatives are (du m and celui-ci. The closing parenthesis remains literal. The local co cancellation is retained: the apparent descending g-like part belongs to the dark zigzag rather than a securely separate underlying letter. No new mathematical check is claimed.
